title: Maps: U-2 missions over Cuba, 5–14 October and multiple missions 15–22 October 1962
description: Continuation page with two maps of Cuba and the surrounding region. The top map plots Mission 3098 (5 October), Mission 3100 (7 October) and Mission 3101 (14 October) with direction arrows; the bottom map, labeled "Multiple missions, 15-22 October," shows dense overlapping flight tracks concentrated over western and central Cuba. Havana, San Cristobal, the Bay of Pigs, Guantanamo Bay and scale bars are labeled; marked Secret NOFORN.
